There is a race condition that showed up in a threaded JIT environment.
The situation is that a process with a JIT code page forks
marked read-only
column2: then some threads are created in the child.  One of the

column1: threads attempts to add a new code block to the JIT page
copy-on-write fault is taken
column2: and the kernel allocates a new page

column1: the data
flush caches to make sure that the icache and dcache are in sync.
Unfortunately
column2: the other thread runs right after the new pte is installed

column1: but before the caches have been flushed.  It tries to execute some old JIT
code that was already in this page
column2: but it sees some garbage in the i-cache

column1: from the previous users of the new physical page.
Fix: we must make the caches consistent before installing the pte.  This is
an ia64 only fix because lazy_mmu_prot_update() is a no-op on all other
architectures.
